name: Classic Woodworks
old_description: Classic Woodworks of MI is a family owned custom woodturning, woodworking and cabinet shop. We specialize in wood turning and one of our favorites is large diameter turned pedestal table bases. We can also duplicate your vintage turnings such as spindles, newel posts, porch posts, etc.  We look forward to hearing from you as to how we can assist you with your home decor or historical restoration project.
about:
Classic Woodworks operates from Capac, Michigan, as a family-owned custom woodturning, woodworking, and cabinet shop. The business is led by Doug Clayton as president, with Luke Clayton serving as shop foreman and lathe operator, and Laura Clayton as office manager.

The company specializes in wood turning, particularly large-diameter turned pedestal table bases, and can duplicate vintage turnings such as spindles, newel posts, and porch posts for historical restoration. Its shop services include wood turning, planing, jointing, sanding, and sizing of sheet goods. They also design, manufacture, and install custom cabinetry, architectural millwork, and a wide range of built-in furniture for residential and commercial spaces.

Classic Woodworks serves homeowners seeking custom home libraries, home theaters, offices, media centers, fireplace surrounds, mantels, bookcases, and wine cellars. Commercial clients include projects for store fixtures, church furniture, staircases, and coffered ceilings. The gallery also shows work in architectural millwork, wainscoting, and custom built-ins for dens and bars.

The company emphasizes its ability to replicate historic turnings and produce large-scale turned components, positioning itself as a resource for both decorative and restoration-focused woodworking.
